verdict.rationale: a-Shell documents its own Apple Shortcuts actions: `Execute Command` runs a list of commands, and `Put File`/`Get File` move files in and out. The README says this gives 'full control of the Shell', so the app has a scriptable automation surface. That surface is limited to Shortcuts actions, though, and probes found no published API spec or llms.txt (openapi/swagger and llms.txt paths all returned 404). Shortcuts may not always work when forced to run 'in App' or 'in Extension'. Missing for 10: a general-purpose public programmatic API (e.g., HTTP/REST or SDK), a formal API reference or spec, agent-oriented docs such as llms.txt, and independent corroboration of reliable automated driving.
